nodes.name: Lemma 1: Error sources identification
nodes.statement:
For a given condition $\mathbf{c}$, denote by $\tilde p^\theta_{\tau_K}(\cdot | \mathbf{c})$ the marginal density of the generated $\tilde{\mathbf{Z}}(\tau_K)$ of the reverse process (6). Under the conditions of Proposition 2, we have
\begin{align}
        &\text{KL}\big(p_{\text{target}}(\cdot | \mathbf{c}) || \tilde p^\theta_{\tau_K}(\cdot | \mathbf{c})\big) \\
        &\lesssim \text{KL}\big(q_{T_g}(\cdot | \mathbf{c}) || \mathcal{N}(0, I_d)\big) +  \sum_{k=1}^{K} \int_{\tau_{k-1}}^{\tau_k}\mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{Y}(\tau)\sim q_\tau(\cdot | \mathbf{c}), \mathbf{Y}(\tau_k)\sim q_{\tau_k|\tau}(\cdot |\mathbf{Y}(\tau), \mathbf{c})}\big[||f(\tau)\mathbf{Y}(\tau) - f(\tau_k)\mathbf{Y}(\tau_k)||^2\big]\mathrm{d}\tau \\
        &\qquad + \sum_{k=1}^{K} \int_{\tau_{k-1}}^{\tau_k}\mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{Y}(\tau)\sim q_\tau(\cdot | \mathbf{c}), \mathbf{Y}(\tau_k)\sim q_{\tau_k | \tau}(\cdot | \mathbf{Y}(\tau), \mathbf{c})}\big[||g^2(\tau)\nabla\log q_\tau(\mathbf{Y}(\tau) | \mathbf{c}) - g^2(\tau_k)\nabla\log q_{\tau_k}(\mathbf{Y}(\tau_k) | \mathbf{c})||^2\big]\mathrm{d}\tau\\
        &\qquad +  \sum_{k=1}^{K}\int_{\tau_{k - 1}}^{\tau_{k}}[g^2(\tau_k) - g^2(\tau)]^2\mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{Y}(\tau)\sim q_{\tau}(\cdot | \mathbf{c})} \big[\big\|\nabla\log q_\tau(\mathbf{Y}(\tau) | \mathbf{c})\big\|^2\big] \mathrm{d}\tau  \\
        &\qquad + \Delta \tau\sum_{k=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{Y}\sim q_{\tau_k}(\cdot | \mathbf{c})}\big[||g^2(\tau_k)\nabla\log q_{\tau_k}(\mathbf{Y}(\tau_k) | \mathbf{c}) - g^2(\tau_k)s_\theta(\tau_k, \mathbf{Y}(\tau_k), \mathbf{c})||^2\big].
\end{align}
